selection: Same causal eligible endpoints for B1 and all S0 seeds within each size; existing uniform per-day quota then deterministic seed-7 global cap, independent of label sign/magnitude. Size levels need not be nested.
primary_statistic: equal-stock then equal-shared-date mean stock/day Spearman IC on paired original-event endpoints
primary_comparison: mean of three S0 seed ICs minus same-size B1 IC; report each seed and all five stocks
finalist_rule: If all sizes complete, carry 200k B1 and all three 200k S0 seeds into FQ3; no June/Sep/Nov-driven size or seed selection. If training limited, retain flag and do not make adequate-training claim.
training_budget: Use authorized available GPU window; do not silently reduce the 200k target or 60-epoch cap. Record per-task device occupancy wall seconds, GPU peak memory, total wall time, failures and retries. A genuine resource/correctness failure is a hard stop.
independent_confirmation: None qualified; all evaluated 2017 dates are previously exposed.
